title: FsStore: .block extension and directory format are undocumented contracts
description: Files are named {cid-base32}.block. Once operators have data on disk this format cannot change without a migration. The .block suffix, base32 encoding of CIDv1, and the flat (non-sharded) directory layout are all permanent decisions not captured anywhere in code comments or docs. A future maintainer could accidentally change cid.to_string() to a different encoding or add subdirectory sharding without realizing this breaks existing stores. Add a doc comment to FsStore::open explaining the storage format as a stable contract.
